title: Future travel plans
summary: Perfective future, two imperfective variants and the present for a scheduled plan.

i.sentenceGloss: Tomorrow I will go to the gallery.
i.note: Future: the simple future of йти is піду.

we.sentenceGloss: After the tour we will go to a coffee shop.
we.note: Future: first person plural of йти.

you.sentenceGloss: On Saturday you will go to an exhibition.
you.note: Future: second person singular of йти.

they.sentenceGloss: Next week they will go to a museum.
they.note: Future: third person plural of йти.

walk.sentenceGloss: In the evening I will be walking along the river.
walk.note: Future of an imperfective verb: the ending changes, not the stem.

walkwe.sentenceGloss: Tomorrow we will be walking slowly.
walkwe.note: Future of an imperfective verb: the ending changes, not the stem.

read.sentenceGloss: On the train I will read a guidebook.
read.note: Future of an imperfective verb: the ending changes, not the stem.

planned.sentenceGloss: Tomorrow morning I am travelling to Lviv.
planned.note: Present tense for a scheduled plan: it is already arranged.
